newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Metroplex in unit equity swap.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Metroplex in unit equity swap.

text.p: Metroplex Bhd said on Wednesday that it had entered into an agreement with Sinophil Corp Inc under which it would swap 25 percent of its interest in its Subic Bay hotel unit for new Sinophil shares.
In a statement, Metroplex said the swap would give it a stake of 21.9 percent of investment holding firm Sinophil's enlarged share capital.
Metroplex's 85-percent unit Subic Bay Resort (HK) Ltd would be involved in the swap.

In addition, Sinophil associate company Belle Corp Inc of the Philippines will make available to Metroplex and minority shareholders options to new shares in Sinophil representing 31.9 percent of 140.71 million options outstanding, the statement said.
After the swap, Metroplex would continue to control Subic Bay Resort as a unit with an effective shareholding directly and indirectly of 68.76 percent.

Metroplex said the deal will provide it with a capital gain of $314 million comprising an immediate realised capital gain of about $125 million and a further unrealised capital gain of about $189 million based on current market prices of Sinophil shares at about 3.2 centavo per share.
Subic Bay Resort operates hotels and casinos as well as a cruise ship.
The transaction values Subic Bay Resort at $516 million based on its prospective net earnings, the statement said.

Metroplex said the swap with Sinophil enables it to strengthen its strategic alliance with Belle as its Philippine partner "in identifying and securing future opportunites for growth in gaming activities", the statement said.
The agreement is subject to the approval of Philippines authorities and is expected to be concluded this year.
